solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Part of castle appropriate for exercises

parts.note: the keep is the central stronghold tower of a castle
fit, as in fitting or suitable

explanation.surface: A section of a castle is deemed the right place for doing workouts.
explanation.definitionFit: Keep-fit is the name for a routine of physical workouts done to stay healthy.

clue.text: European mentioned part of fish

indicators.note: something mentioned is spoken, so the word is taken by how it sounds when said

parts.note: a fin is a part of a fish used for swimming

explanation.surface: Someone from Europe brings up a fishy body part.
explanation.definitionFit: A Finn is a native of Finland, a country in northern Europe.

clue.text: Walk ostentatiously for instance around tree

indicators.note: around tells us one piece wraps the other in this clue

parts.note: say is used to mean for instance, as in 'a fruit, say'
the ash is a common tree

explanation.surface: A showy stroller parades round a tree, for example.
explanation.definitionFit: To sashay is to strut or swagger along in a showy, swaying manner.

clue.text: Exotic root included in previous times in dish

indicators.note: included in places one piece inside another

parts.note: the past is previous times

indicators.note: exotic suggests something foreign and strange, so the word's letters are made strange by rearranging

explanation.surface: An exotic root found in a historic dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Previous times' wants to be read as the definition with 'dish' as wordplay, but the dish is the definition and 'Exotic' scrambles only the root.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot roast is a dish of meat browned and then slowly braised in a covered pot.

clue.text: Fish, perhaps? Then raw meat cooked with time running out

indicators.note: cooked hints that the ingredients are worked over into a new arrangement
running out says one piece is lost from the mixture before it is rearranged

explanation.surface: A recipe: take raw meat and cook it, but the clock is ticking.
explanation.walkthrough: THEN RAW MEAT, less the T for time ('running out'), is rearranged ('cooked'). Michael Fish was a long-serving BBC television weather forecaster in Britain, famous for dismissing a storm in 1987.
explanation.definitionFit: Michael Fish is an example of a TV weather forecaster, hence the 'perhaps'.

clue.text: Backs element in legal case

definitions.meaning: in football the backs are the players who form the rearguard
the side in a trial answering the prosecution's charge

explanation.definitionFit: Defence names both a team's rearguard players and the accused's side in court.

clue.text: Key impression made around motorway north

indicators.note: made around says one piece is built round the others

parts.note: a seal is an impression stamped in wax
the M1 is Britain's first motorway, written MI in crosswords

explanation.surface: An important stamp made near a northern motorway.
explanation.definitionFit: Seminal work is key or highly influential, shaping later developments.

clue.text: Old Chancellor with very regal character at all events

parts.note: Geoffrey Howe was Chancellor of the Exchequer under Margaret Thatcher
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the royal cipher of the Queen

explanation.surface: A former Treasury minister with a decidedly kingly manner.
explanation.walkthrough: The Chancellor of the Exchequer is Britain's finance minister.
explanation.definitionFit: However can mean nevertheless or in any case, just like 'at all events'.

clue.text: On which a cross may be exhibited for those standing?

definitions.text: On which a cross may be exhibited for those standing?

parts.words: On which a cross may be exhibited for those standing?
parts.note: voters mark an X beside the candidates who are standing for election, not a cross on show to an upright crowd

explanation.surface: Something displaying a crucifix for a congregation on its feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Voters put a cross on this slip next to the candidate they choose at an election.

clue.text: Uncertain situation for a high-flier?

definitions.meaning: literally the position of something flying high, aloft

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means unresolved, and literally describes something aloft in the sky.

clue.text: Drop reportedly in rank

indicators.note: reportedly means as spoken or heard, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: a tear is a drop from the eye

explanation.surface: A drop is said to be in the ranks.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is a row or level, as a rank is a row in a series.

clue.text: Only nameless lad is sadly lacking faith

indicators.note: sadly suggests things have gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled
nameless means without N, the abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: A lonely boy without a name is sadly lacking faith.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nameless' drops N from ONLY to give OLY; 'sadly' rearranges OLY with LAD IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Being disloyal means being unfaithful to someone or something one ought to support.

clue.text: High street concern as a French doctor with little energy tucked into coffee

indicators.note: tucked into puts the doctor and companions inside the coffee

parts.note: a latte is a milky coffee
un is French for a
E is the abbreviation, a little bit, of energy

explanation.surface: A French physician with low energy gets stuck into a coffee on the high street.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'concern' is a business, and the high street is the main shopping street of a British town.
explanation.definitionFit: A launderette is a self-service laundry business found among the shops of a high street.

clue.text: A dope clearly disheartened in business

parts.note: dope and gen both mean information

indicators.note: disheartened removes the heart of the word, leaving only its outside letters

explanation.surface: A drug user is plainly downcast at work.
explanation.definitionFit: An agency is a business providing a service, such as a travel or estate agency.

clue.text: Property magazine giving one chance to be with loved ones?

definitions.text: chance to be with loved ones?

parts.note: a quality is a property or characteristic
Time is a well-known news magazine

explanation.surface: A property magazine lets a reader spend time with family.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means time spent giving full attention to family or friends.

clue.text: Beer glass manufactured with no end of aplomb making substantial gift?

indicators.note: manufactured suggests the letters are made over into something new
no says the following letter is missing from the mix
end of picks out the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A beer glass made without much poise turns out to be a lavish present.
explanation.walkthrough: BEER GLASS less B (the last letter of 'aplomb', 'no end of') is rearranged ('manufactured').
explanation.definitionFit: Largesse is generous giving, especially lavish gifts of money.

clue.text: Indian tourist site appears in dull plan

indicators.note: appears in places the site inside the dull word

parts.note: dim means dull, lacking brightness
Agra, home of the Taj Mahal, is a major Indian tourist destination

explanation.surface: An Indian attraction features in a boring plan.
explanation.definitionFit: A diagram is a drawn plan or outline showing how something is laid out.

clue.text: Austere figure from church stopping wine clubs

indicators.note: stopping means plugging a gap, so one piece goes into another

parts.note: Asti is a sparkling Italian wine
CE is the Church of England
C is the abbreviation for the card suit clubs

explanation.surface: A stern churchman shuts down the wine at the clubs.
explanation.definitionFit: An ascetic is a person who practises severe self-denial, an austere figure.

clue.text: Beam and bloody equipment having to be put back

indicators.note: put back means the whole run is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: red is the colour of blood, so bloody
a rig is equipment or gear

explanation.surface: A beam and some bloody kit have to be returned.
explanation.definitionFit: A girder is a large iron or steel beam used in building.

clue.text: Criminal is a sort to possess naphtha initially

definitions.text: Criminal is a sort to possess naphtha initially

indicators.note: to possess means one piece holds another inside it
criminal suggests the letters are corrupted, so rearranged
initially picks out the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A villain is the type to carry naphtha.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Criminal' rearranges IS A SORT to ARSOIST, which holds N, the first letter of 'naphtha' ('initially'). Naphtha is a flammable oil, apt for a fire-raiser.
explanation.definitionFit: An arsonist is a criminal who sets fires, and might carry naphtha to do it.

clue.text: Train group of swimmers?

definitions.meaning: a shoal of fish is called a ...

explanation.definitionFit: School means to teach or discipline, and is also a large group of fish.

clue.text: Student gripped by selfishness retracted amorous glance

indicators.note: gripped by means the student is held inside the other piece
retracted means drawn back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: ego, self-regard, is selfishness
L is a learner driver, a student

explanation.surface: A student caught in selfishness withdrew a lustful look.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogle is a leering or amorous look at someone.

clue.text: Fair woman getting measure of horse in end possibly

parts.note: Eve is a woman's name

indicators.note: in puts the measure inside the other piece
possibly suggests a different arrangement of the letters

parts.note: a hand is the four-inch unit used for a horse's height

explanation.surface: A fair woman measures a horse at the finish.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'horse' suggests a mount or a nag, but here only its height unit matters, and 'end possibly' signals a reshuffle rather than a final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Even-handed means fair and impartial in treating everyone alike.

clue.text: Set of tables featuring in fine store

indicators.note: featuring in means the answer is found inside these words

explanation.surface: Furniture appears in a good shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A nest of tables is a set of small tables that stack inside each other.

clue.text: Mental image of fellow worker when by yard

parts.note: an ant is a worker insect
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: A colleague imagines things when standing by the yard.
explanation.definitionFit: A fantasy is an imagined picture or daydream in the mind.

clue.text: Lower figure in field getting plant

parts.note: a lower is something that lows, or moos, so a cow
slip is a fielding position in cricket, so a figure in the field

explanation.surface: Something lower in a field acquires a plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lower' is not the comparative of low but one who lows. In cricket the slips stand beside the wicketkeeper.
explanation.definitionFit: The cowslip is a wild primula with yellow flowers found in meadows.
